nodes.label: Gap: admin routes not uniformly under /api/v1/admin/*
nodes.rationale: SRS.md §5 specifies a uniform /api/v1/admin/* guard; running code instead mounts admin actions on the same router as public counterparts, differentiated by HTTP method + requireRole('admin') per-route; blog module partially nests admin reads under /blog/admin/* but this isn't applied consistently elsewhere.
nodes.norm_label: gap: admin routes not uniformly under /api/v1/admin/*

nodes.label: Pricing rule: price = promoPrice ?? basePrice
nodes.rationale: No modifiers, no variants — one price per product, consistent with flat product model.

nodes.label: Valid order status transitions
nodes.rationale: Enforced in order.service.ts, not the schema; customers may only cancel from pending, every other transition is admin-only via PATCH /orders/:id/status.

nodes.label: Stock decrements atomically at order placement
nodes.rationale: SRS D4: stock decrements in the same operation that creates the order (not at completed) to prevent two guests from both successfully ordering the last unit; insufficient stock rejects with 400 and no order is created; cancellation restores stock via an event listener.
nodes.norm_label: stock decrements atomically at order placement

nodes.label: Voucher perUserLimit keyed by phone, not userId
nodes.rationale: SRS D6: vouchers are redeemed by phone number, not userId, since checkout never requires an account (guest checkout).
nodes.norm_label: voucher peruserlimit keyed by phone, not userid

nodes.label: Cloudinary unconfigured → picsum.photos fallback
nodes.rationale: When CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME/API_KEY/API_SECRET are unconfigured, image URLs fall back to picsum.photos stub images during development; picsum.photos must be allowed in apps/storefront/next.config.ts.

nodes.label: verifyToken vs optionalVerifyToken distinction
nodes.rationale: verifyToken distinguishes an expired token (cause === 'JWT_EXPIRED', retry after refresh) from an invalid/missing one (cause: null, redirect to /login immediately); optionalVerifyToken never returns 401 for bad/absent token, silently treats the request as a guest — used on POST /orders and POST /vouchers/validate.
